claims.text: The verdicts are per kind; no pooled depicted-kinds verdict exists.

evidence.description: The endings-atlas design's R10-R11 and section 5: the per-kind test is Fisher's exact (two-sided) on the pooled 2x2 against the frequency-matched comparison, at the 5 percent level; SUPPORTED requires ratio >= 1.5, significance, and the half-of-occurrences condition; NOT SUPPORTED is ratio <= 1.0; anything else is INCONCLUSIVE; below a floor is TOO THIN; and no pooled 'depicted signs' verdict exists under the design.

evidence.description: Spec 071's frozen sections 4.2-4.4 carry the machinery this spec takes over per kind: the pooled final-position rate, the frequency-matched comparison, the two-sided Fisher exact combination, and the per-sign report published in full so one frequent sign cannot carry a class silently.
